plain_statement: Is there, on fifteen inputs a_v, b_v, c_v (inputs v, 5 + v, 10 + v), v = 0..4, a monotone formula of depth at most 6 for the OR over the 5-cycle's edges uv of (MAJ(a_u, b_u, c_u) AND MAJ(a_v, b_v, c_v)) (MAJ: at least two of three true)? A monotone formula: a tree of fan-in-two AND and OR gates over the inputs, no NOT, no constants; depth at most d is said as: the function lies in level d of every family of sets of functions that holds the inputs at level 0, keeps each level in the next, and puts the AND and the OR of two level-k functions in level k + 1. Conjecture.
title: Probe: Search: a monotone fan-in-two AND/OR formula of depth at most 6 for the 5-cycle with each input a majority of three inputs
